title: Hawaii Army National Guard assists residents in evacuation during Kona Low storm
description: Members of the Hawaii Army National Guard assisted in the evacuation on the north shore of Oahu during the second Kona Low storm in two weeks. The Hawaii Army National Guard used their light medium tactical vehicles to transport the stranded residents from a Red Cross gathering point at Waialua High School to a shelter location at Leileihua High School. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Retired Master Sgt. Andrew Jackson).
